en: Sepia-toned historic street view of a European town. The image shows a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story masonry buildings, shop signs, gas-style street lamps and some trees on the right. A horse-drawn cart stands in the middle of the street, and several pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the scene as 'Rosswein. Bahnhofstrasse.' indicating a view of the town's station street.
